hook: She knew every child on her road. Or so she thought.
excerpt: ‘I didn’t look. You don’t look where they come from. You look at the road.’

excerpt.text: That if a child crossed her road four afternoons running she knew who that child was, or could find out by Friday, because that was what she did, and the street was hers.

caption:
Eleven years as the lollipop lady outside St Anne’s. She knows every child. So who is the girl with the fox on her bag?
